t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice given was advising which gnomes to go for and letting us know that the order does switch and if that is the case switch options

vb_textbox.text: I struggled to see a pattern at first but I then noticed certain colours would give you less points but not on every go. I think for each participant the patterns may change, so it may be worth looking for any patterns e.g. when you choose the red gnome on every other go you get more points or lower points.
